purpose: Attribution of five measured slow classes under the current first-tier and worker settings; instrumented times are not speedup comparisons.

jfr.limits: Java execution samples and native-method stack samples are separate. Native samples include blocking I/O and are not CPU attribution. Inclusive counts overlap. Neither sample count is exact CPU time. Native samples do not resolve Rust internals. Compilation durations are activity intervals, not compiler CPU seconds. Allocation weights are sampled estimates. Instrumented elapsed times are not speedup evidence.

jdk11.limits: All 2759 invocations passed without skips. Hosted postprocessing failed on the Java 11 compilation event schema; recordings were reprocessed locally with the corrected reader and 2 GiB reader heap. No test rerun. Fixture/elapsed/CPU summary was not retained before that exporter failure, so those values are not claimed.

protobuf_recompilation.scope: Actual Maven/protobuf/compiler fixture, Java11, protobuf plugin0.6.1, compiler3.13.0, protoc/protobuf4.32.1; behavior/invalidation check, not a hosted CI timing claim.
protobuf_recompilation.rejected: protoc.skip=true drops the generated test-source root and caused a real dependent-source compilation failure; it is not used.
protobuf_recompilation.limits: The staleness flag is enabled only after a full compile in the same immutable CI checkout/job. Normal initial compilation remains responsible for proto and generator-version changes.

runtime_slow_mix_workers.config: Two alternating pairs, first-tier compiler fixed, two fresh 4 GiB vs four fresh 2 GiB forks. No JFR, fixture timers or fixture-plan caching. Same four-CPU runner and total 8 GiB Java heap budget.
runtime_slow_mix_workers.limits: Every individual class slowed under four forks, while additional overlap shortened aggregate completion. Earlier four-class probe was dominated by string-collection time and did not measure this broader worker throughput. Full required matrix must qualify the chosen setting; gains are not multiplied with separate cache probes.

canonical_workers.config: Eight complete canonical classes, 64 cases per phase, one separate metadata preparation followed by two alternating two/four-fork pairs. First-tier compilation and existing 1 GiB child engine workers retained; parents use two 2 GiB or four 1 GiB forks; no added required runner jobs.
canonical_workers.limits: Preparation cost is recorded separately; timing comparisons use prepared immutable metadata. Full required matrix must establish cold job setup, complete coverage, memory and whole-workflow costs. CPU increases are reported; sampled memory counters are not peak RSS.

fixture_plan_cache.config: Two alternating pairs per JDK on 2,759 unchanged cases. First-tier compiler fixed, original reference worker budgets: JDK 11 two 4 GiB forks; JDK 17 four 2 GiB forks. No JFR or fixture timers. Unopened definitions serialized; every scenario deserializes independent operators.
fixture_plan_cache.limits: Selected workload comparison under each recorded worker budget; no whole-matrix claim and no multiplication with separate concurrency probes. Full CI must qualify defaults, remaining fixtures, native/recovery assertions and combined settings.

fixture_plan_cache.scope: Two execution-test fixture builders, independent deserialization, bounded128entries32MiB each

selected_settings.protobuf_staleness: Only later lifecycle calls within the same immutable CI job; initial compilation and local defaults regenerate normally.
